title: Code Mania 1011 (2024): Deep dive into the definition and future of AI in software development
image1Description: Attending the technology seminar on the topic AI for Developers at Code Mania 1011

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: In an era where AI plays an important role in the technology industry, I intended to keep up with this change. I joined the Code Mania 1011 (2024) event under the topic 'AI for Developers' to find out what AI really is, how it works behind the scenes, and how it will change the direction of software work. My goal was to learn and apply it to real work, not just seeing it as a worrying or distant matter.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I attended deep-dive lectures on many topics, from the basics of how AI works to advanced applications. This included using AI to help with Coding to increase work efficiency, AI Training, and ways to use AI in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) process. Additionally, I exchanged viewpoints with other developers to analyze the limits and possibilities of AI in the near future.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The main challenge was separating 'reality' from 'over-worrying' (AI Hype vs Reality). I had to understand security and privacy when using AI in an organization. This included adapting from being a traditional Coder to being an AI director (AI-Driven Development) to get the most accurate and safe results, which required a lot of Re-skilling.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: Attending this event helped me realize that AI is not a tool to replace developers, but a powerful 'Co-pilot' that helps expand our abilities beyond old limits. I gained ideas for using AI to help with Code Review and designing a more flexible System Architecture. This experience changed my view from being just a user to being a co-developer of sustainable innovation with artificial intelligence.
